compose.title: Leave a comment

conflict.title: This comment changed

errors.title: That did not go through

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do that here.
errors.invalid: Some of what you sent is not valid. Check the form and try again.
errors.not_found: This no longer exists, or you cannot see it.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session ended. Sign in and try again.

issues.edit_window_closed: The time to edit this has run out. Ask a moderator if something needs fixing.

unhide.title: Comment visible again
unhide.desc: Everyone can read it under the article.

delete.desc: It is removed for everyone and cannot be restored. Replies to it stay in the conversation.

done.title: Comment deleted
done.desc: It is gone from the conversation.
